questions.question:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

 1, 3, 6, 11, 18, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

1 **+ 2** → 3 **+ 3** → 6 **+ 5** → 11** + 7** → 18 + ?

In the given series prime numbers are added in the previous number,

So, 11 which is next prime number after 7 will be added to 18.

→ 18 + 11 = 29

Hence, next number in the series is 29.

questions.question: Among four books, Book 1 is twice as heavy as Book 2. Book 3's weight is half of Book 2's weight. Book 4 is 60 grams more as compared to Book 2 but 60 grams less as compared Book 1. Which book is heaviest?
questions.solution:
Let the weight of Book 2 is x grams

Weight of Book 1 = 2x (given: twice as heavy as Book 2)

Weight of Book 3 = x/2 (given: half of Book 2's weight)

Weight of Book 4 = x + 60 & 2x – 60 (given)

→ x + 60 = 2x – 60

→ **120 grams** = x (weight of Book 2)

Weight of Book 2 = 2x → 2 × 120

= **240 grams**

Weight of Book 3 = x/2 → 120/2

= **60 grams**Weight of Book 4 = x + 60 → 120 + 60

= **180 grams**

Clearly, Book 1 is heaviest among all the books.

questions.question: For which of the following game, players must have the knowledge of Pascal's law?
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

Pascal's Law:

__
 
• It states that if the gravity effect is neglected, the pressure at every point of liquid in the equilibrium of rest is the same.
 
• The increase in pressure at one point of the enclosed liquid in an equilibrium of rest is transmitted equally to all other points of the liquid and also to the walls of the container, provided the effect of gravity is neglected.

EXPLANATION__:

 
• Pascal's principle states that pressure applied to fluids is equally transmitted in all directions, to all parts of the fluid and to all parts of a container.
 
• Scuba divers must also understand this principle as at a depth of 10 meters underwater, the pressure is twice the atmospheric pressure at the sea surface, and increases by about 100 kPa for each increase of 10 m depth. Therefore option 4 is correct.

questions.question: In the Indian Parliamentary System, 'Vote on Account' is valid for how many months (except the year of elections)?
questions.solution:
Option **1** is correct, i.e. __**2 months**__.

__
 
• Normally, the vote-on-account is taken for two months only. But during an election year or when it is anticipated that the main Demands and Appropriation Bill will take a longer time than **two months**__, the vote-on-account may be for a period extending two months.
 
• A '**Vote-on-Account**' budget is only concerned with the expenditure part of the Government of India and there is no reference to the revenue earning of the government. 
 
• It is a mechanism by which the government can carry on functioning till the time a full budget is passed. 
 
• A vote-on-account budget is generally passed for __**two months**__ but in election years and also in cases where it is expected that the full budget will take a longer time to get approved, it can be passed for a period exceeding two months also.

questions.solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**Estrogen** (American English) or oestrogen (British English) is the primary female sex hormone as well as a medication.

__
 
• It is responsible for the development and regulation of the female reproductive system and secondary sex characteristics.
 
• Estrogens are synthesized in all vertebrates as well as some insects.
 
• Their presence in both vertebrates and insects suggests that estrogenic sex hormones have an ancient evolutionary history. 
 
• While estrogen levels are significantly lower in males compared to females, estrogens nevertheless also have important physiological roles in males.

**Progesterone and estrogen are two female sex hormone**__s released into woman's ovary by the bloodstream.

 
• **Testosterone is a male sex hormone** produced by testes also called testicles.

questions.question: If sqrt {5x - 6} + sqrt {5x + 6} = 6, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
We can do this question by checking the options

Let x = - 4

⇒ √{5 (- 4) – 6}, negative term in the square root which is not correct

⇒ option 1 is not Ans

Let x = 0

⇒ √{0 – 6} = √(- 6), negative term in the square root which is not correct

⇒ option 2 is not Ans

Let x = 2

⇒ √{5 (2) – 6} + √{5 (2) + 6}

⇒ √4 + √16 = 2 + 4 = 6 = RHS

⇒ option 3 is Ans

Let x = - 4

⇒ √{5 (4) – 6} + √{5 (4) + 6} , which is not equal to 6

⇒ option 4 is not Ans

∴ the Ans is x = 2

questions.question: The side BC of ΔABC is produced to D. If ∠ACD = 114° and ∠ABC = (1/2)∠BAC, then what is the value (in degrees) of ∠BAC?
questions.solution:
Let ∠ABC be x then ∠BAC = 2x

Using Exterior angle property

⇒ ∠CAB + ∠ABC = ∠ ACD

⇒ 2x + x = 114

⇒ x = 38

⇒ ∠BAC = 2x = 2 × 38 = 76

∴ ∠BAC is 76

questions.question: O is the center of the circle and two tangents are drawn from a point P to this circle at points A and B. If ∠AOP = 50°, then what is the value (in degrees) of ∠APB?
questions.solution:
Since we know that ∠POA = ∠POB = 50

⇒ ∠AOB = 50 + 50 = 100

Now in quadrilateral PAOB

⇒ ∠APB + ∠PAO + ∠AOB + ∠OBP = 360

⇒ ∠BPA = 360 - 90 - 90 - 100 = 80 (∵∠PAO = 90 and ∠AOB = 90 because they are tangent)

∴ ∠APB = 80

Perimeter of tyre can be given as = πD = (22/7) × 21

Distance covered by cyclist in 45 minutes or 45/60 hrs can be given as

questions.question: The average age of Ram and Rahim is 18 years. The average age of Rahim and Ramesh is 25 years. The average age of Ram and Ramesh is 29 years. What is the age (in years) of the eldest of the three?
questions.solution:
Let the age of Ram, Rahim and Ramesh be p, q and r respectively

Given that the average age of Ram and Rahim is 18 years, it can be written as

⇒ (p + q)/2 = 18

⇒ p + q = 36 ----(i)

Given that the average age of Rahim and Ramesh is 25 years, it can be written as

⇒ (q + r)/2 = 25

⇒ q + r = 50 ----(ii)

Given that the average age of Ram and Ramesh is 29 years, it can be written as

⇒ (p + r)/2 = 29

⇒ p + r = 58 ----(iii)

(iii) - (ii)

⇒ p - q = 8 ----(iv)

(i) + (iv)

⇒ 2p = 44

⇒ p = 22 Use this in (iv)

⇒ 22 - q = 8

⇒ q = 14 Put this in (ii)

⇒ 14 + r = 50

⇒ r = 36

∴ The age of eldest one is 36 years

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Active/Passive voice. Out of four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active voice.**

I hope that I shall win this dance competition.

options.text: It is hoped that the dance competition will be won by me.
Winning the dance competition is hoped by me.
Dance competition winning is my hope.
The dance competition is hoped to be won.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **‘It is hoped that the dance competition will be won by me.’** 

Sentence 2 makes winning the primary subject over hope, which is incorrect as the Active voice is different.

Sentence 3 is grammatically and structurally incorrect and does not convey the same meaning.

Sentence 4 removes the ‘me’ part and completely changes the meaning of the sentence, making it incorrect.

Only **Sentence 1** retains the meaning of the sentence and accurately converts the Active voice into Passive voice.

questions.solution:

**’The reason for her outburst at the party is yet unknown.’**
